composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing the
# offending field names before any entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateNewOwner
  next: uniqueTelephone

# Reject a create whose normalized telephone is already used by another owner (409),
# before any entity is built or persisted.
uniqueTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueTelephone
  next: uniqueHousehold

# A household is same last name at the same address (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed).
# Read-only gate: reject a create that joins an existing household with a 409, unless the
# request set 'sharesHousehold' true — in which case it publishes the household's stable
# 'householdId' for the steps below. Runs before any entity is built or persisted.
uniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueHousehold
  next: applyHousehold

# When joining a shared household, back-fill the published 'householdId' onto existing members
# so the whole household carries the same id. A no-op otherwise.
applyHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplySharedHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          type: boolean

          example: false

        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      allOf:

        - type: object

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

## Summary

Implemented `namesakeCount` on the owner-creation flow of `POST /api/owners`, returned via `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

**What it does:** When an owner is created, the system counts how many *existing* owners already share the same `firstName` **and** `lastName` (compared case-insensitively), computed *before* the new owner is persisted so the value is fixed at creation time, then stores it and returns it on the owner resource.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` (integer, int32, min 0) property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it automatically.

4. **`function/owner/BuildOwner.java`** — the create pipeline's build step (which already enumerates owners for the customer-code sequence) now also counts case-insensitive first+last name matches over `findAll()` *before* `SaveOwner` runs, and sets it on the entity.

This follows the OfficeFloor conventions in AGENTS.md (no new `@RestController`, logic lives in a function step within the existing POST pipeline) and keeps the value stable after creation by persisting it rather than recomputing at read time.
